items.content_text: - **BTA Sports expands into prediction markets with AI-powered analytics in its fourth quarter Version 2.0 rollout, GlobeNewswire reports** — GlobeNewswire reports BTA Sports, a subscription sports analytics platform, announced on October 21 that its Version 2.0 release in the fourth quarter will add sports prediction market tools, comparing market prices with its own probability model through a personalized feed and an Ask BTA feature.
